market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility ahead of CPI and Fed reaction. Oil at $108 and 10Y near 5% create headwinds. Stocks may consolidate as inflation data and geopolitical oil risk dominate. Bond market remains fragile post-Bessent backfire. Expect 2-4% equity volatility over next 2-3 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle supports tech leadership through 2027. BRICS realignment gradually shifts trade flows. Copper and energy supply constraints create structural tailwinds for commodities. Housing market faces 12-18 month adjustment at 7%+ rates. Fed likely maintains restrictive stance into Q1 2027.
